def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    # cache maps key -> value
    # write_time maps key -> time when it was written
    cache = {}
    write_time = {}
    # OrderedDict to track LRU order (most recent at end)
    lru_order = OrderedDict()
    
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Check if key exists and is not expired
            key_exists = key in cache and write_time[key] + ttl > t
            
            if key_exists:
                # Key exists and not expired, update it
                cache[key] = value
                write_time[key] = t
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                lru_order.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                # Key doesn't exist or is expired
                # If key was expired, remove it first
                if key in cache:
                    del cache[key]
                    del write_time[key]
                    del lru_order[key]
                
                # If cache is at capacity, evict LRU
                if len(cache) >= capacity:
                    lru_key, _ = lru_order.popitem(last=False)
                    del cache[lru_key]
                    del write_time[lru_key]
                
                # Add new entry
                cache[key] = value
                write_time[key] = t
                lru_order[key] = True
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Check if key exists and is not expired
            if key in cache and write_time[key] + ttl > t:
                # Entry exists and is not expired
                value = cache[key]
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                lru_order.move_to_end(key)
                results.append(value)
            else:
                # Entry doesn't exist or is expired
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
